associations.rationale: The type gives the total number of conjugacy classes, q^2-1, which is a consequence of summing the four table rows rather than a displayed source claim.
The type counts all elliptic elements, a consequence of the table's class size and class count rather than either displayed entry itself.
The type counts all parabolic elements, obtained by multiplying the displayed number and size of parabolic classes.
The type counts all scalar elements; this is a consequence of the table rather than its class-size or class-count assertion.
The type counts all split semisimple elements, a derived total not directly displayed in the source table.
The type directly gives the elliptic centralizer size q^2-1 stated in the detailed explanation below the table.
The q(q-1) parabolic-centralizer count is derived from the commuting-matrix form, rather than directly stating that form or a table entry.
The centralizer cardinality |GL2| is a consequence of the source's centrality statement, not the centrality statement itself.
The (q-1)^2 centralizer count is derived from the diagonal-centralizer description and supports the conjugacy-class size calculation.
The type directly states that each elliptic conjugacy class has q^2-q elements, as in the table.
The type directly states that each parabolic conjugacy class has q^2-1 elements, as in the table.
The type directly states that a scalar conjugacy class has one element, matching the table.
The type directly states that each split semisimple conjugacy class has q^2+q elements, the table's hyperbolic row.
The type directly partitions every GL2 element into exactly one of the scalar, parabolic, split semisimple, or elliptic types listed in the table.
The type directly states that every elliptic element is conjugate to the displayed elliptic representative form.
The type directly states that every parabolic element is conjugate to a Jordan representative of the form shown in the table.
The type directly states that every scalar element is conjugate to a scalar representative from the table.
The type directly states that every split semisimple element is conjugate to a diagonal representative with distinct eigenvalues.
The type directly gives q(q-1)/2 elliptic classes, matching the third column of the table.
The type directly gives q-1 parabolic classes, matching the table.
The type directly gives q-1 scalar classes, matching the table.
The type directly gives (q-1)(q-2)/2 split semisimple classes, matching the hyperbolic row.
